description:
Rename a project: the name shown in the user's project list, the editor's title and the live page. The same change as clicking the title in the R3 editor, kept at once in the project's live copy (every open R3 tab shows it).

The public address does not change: a preview or live link keeps working. Scripts are not affected (they never address the project by name). Renaming a COMPONENT is not this tool: that is done in the R3 editor.

name.description: The new name. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed. Max 120 characters.

projectId.description: The project to rename, from r3_project_list or r3_project_create.

name: r3_project_rename

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Rename an R3 project
